episode.brief: A message arrived during my active airport ride. Delegate live travel recovery and client-presentation continuity to two parallel workers, then integrate the safest reversible plan. Prepare actions and drafts only; do not change the ride or send anything without me.

source.adaptation: Retains the deterministic ride, message, flight, quote, and shop state and adds a coupled client-presentation continuity stream whose authentication dependency makes pouch contents consequential.

summary: Evaluate a live airport diversion and protect a time-sensitive client presentation in parallel, then route one traveler-held fact into the shared recovery decision.
title: Mid-ride airport and client continuity recovery
